title: Analytics
description: What people ask about, and how the work is spread across your team.
noGotchaSection: There is no “what GOTCHA did” section yet. It needs a breakdown of why the AI handed a conversation to a person, and the platform records the handover without recording the cause — so any chart here would be invented rather than measured.

team.heading: Who is holding what
team.today: These are today's numbers. They reset at midnight, and they are the only period this panel covers.
team.none: Nobody on the team is set up to take conversations yet.
team.humansOnly: This is the human team. GOTCHA's AI employees are not in this list, so it is smaller than the people and machines actually working.
team.unavailable: We couldn't read the team's workload just now.
team.noSpeed: There's no reply-speed column here. The only timing GOTCHA records measures from when a conversation was claimed to each reply in it, so it grows with how long a conversation runs — beside a name that would read as slowness.

asked.heading: What people ask about
asked.grouped: GOTCHA grouped these questions itself. Two lines can be the same question worded differently — it hasn't learned to merge them yet.
asked.none: Nothing has been grouped yet. This fills in as conversations are analysed.
asked.unavailable: We couldn't read what people are asking about just now.

screenSubline: Last 7 days, compared with the week before

changed.unavailable: We couldn't read what changed just now.

kpi.unavailable: We couldn't read this week's figures just now.

teamShort.today: Today's numbers — they reset at midnight.
teamShort.none: Nobody on the team takes conversations yet.

hero.title: It answered first in {count, plural, one {conversation} other {conversations}}.
hero.hours: That's about {hours} hours your team didn't spend typing.

stopped.title: Where it stopped
stopped.unknown: {count} it didn't know the answer to.

alone.title: Alone, or with a person
alone.none: Nothing splits a day's conversations by who answered them yet.

did.title: What it actually did
did.none: It didn't run anything this week.
did.unavailable: We couldn't read what it ran just now.
did.foot: {failed} failed; {refused} were stopped by a rule, which is the rule working.
did.allOneCause: All {count} failures were {name} actions, and the {name} connection is down.
did.someOneCause: {count} of the {total} failures were {name} actions, and the {name} connection is down.

hero.uneven: {heavy} is carrying the queue {light} is.
hero.even: Open conversations are spread evenly right now.
hero.measured: Counted as conversations open now — a queue, not a measure of anyone.

handover.title: The handover works
handover.none: Nothing measures yet how fast a passed-over conversation is picked up, or how often it comes back.

table.foot: Open now and taken today are today's numbers. Replies and outcomes aren't measured per person yet, so nobody here is ranked.

hero.title: What conversations sold isn't known yet.
hero.line: Sales aren't tied to the conversation that led to them, so there's nothing honest to add up.

lost.none: Nobody asked for anything you don't stock this week.

sources.title: Where the money came from
sources.none: Nothing ties a sale to the conversation, recommendation or campaign behind it yet.
sources.foot: How reply speed affects buying isn't measured yet.
